1-2.label: Non-functional
1-2.description: Fellow is absent, disengaged, or causing harm. Supervisor has no confidence in them.

3-4.label: Below expectations
3-4.description: Fellow shows up but is unreliable, does not follow through, or needs constant supervision.

5-6.label: Meeting basic expectations
5-6.description: Fellow is reliable and completes assigned tasks but shows limited initiative or systems thinking.

7-8.label: Strong performer
7-8.description: Fellow takes ownership, builds systems, earns team trust, and drives measurable improvements.

9-10.label: Exceptional
9-10.description: Fellow operates like a leader, creates lasting organizational change, and is seen as indispensable.
